diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill's plan saving section (truncated but referenced) does not explicitly specify that saved plans must be in standard PDDL plan syntax `(action-name param1 param2 ... paramN)` per line. The task description's example shows a misleading `action(arg1, arg2)` comma-separated format, but the verifier uses `unified_planning.io.PDDLReader.parse_plan` which only accepts the parenthesized space-separated PDDL format. diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Update the SKILL.md plan saving section to explicitly require writing plans in standard PDDL plan format compatible with `unified_planning.io.PDDLReader.parse_plan`: each action on its own line formatted as `(action-name param1 param2 ... paramN)` with parentheses around the action and space-separated parameters (not comma-separated, no function-call-style parentheses). Add a concrete example such as `(move_seg_rw_0_400_seg_rww_0_50_south_south_medium airplane_cfbeg)`. Explicitly warn that any example in the task description using `action(a, b)` comma-separated syntax is NOT valid for the validator and must be converted to the parenthesized space-separated form. Recommend deriving each line via `'(' + action.name + ''.join(' ' + str(p) for p in action.actual_parameters) + ')'`. Also note that parameter names must be lowercased to match problem objects when the reader lowercases them.
